title: Review of Guest Speech Content at the Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference p07 NetEase Games Zhou Deming Empowering Game Development with Marvelous Designer: Core Advantages and Practical Points
description:
Thank you to all the guests for their wonderful speeches and valuable insights at the Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference!

In this conference, we delved into the powerful appeal of Marvelous Designer in game production and virtual creation. From the joint growth of Marvelous Designer and its users to the shocking release of new features for 2025, the presentations covered practical tips for game character costume design and specifically explained how Marvelous Designer interacts with Unreal Engine to enhance the realism of virtual clothing.

Don’t miss out on these exciting insights!

Today, I would like to share with you some examples of projects at NetEase. ## Project Introduction: Destiny Rising First of all, I would like to introduce our project. This project was launched in November last year. It is officially named Destiny Rising. It is an IP mobile game for Destiny, allowing users to authorize IPs and search for images. NetEase is developing it independently, essentially encompassing the complete process of Destiny. The background is also a worldview. We'll start with a coverage clip from last year. Let's take a look at the video we watched during Flash. This is what we saw at last year's Naon Live. Let's start with the clip. ## Project Development Process Even though there are 30 images, some of the characters move, and there are some changes or bugs in the equipment. This can be verified in advance. From the product perspective, the corresponding character plan can run in this game in advance. Although it is only a blur, it can verify some design movements, including the special effects of skills, etc. As it is a design game, we are also developing some weapons. For example, in the process of gun development, if we develop a G10 million or a G10 million, we will verify in advance whether its opening and closing states or trigger structure is reasonable at the whiteboard stage. I think this whiteboard process is very good and is also a recognition of the Bungie team. ## Advantages of Marvelous Designer The first point I want to introduce is the actual development of the project. It helps designers quickly improve design efficiency due to its quick implementation effect and function. It also helps us evaluate the design plan through a more intuitive effect and quickly adjust it, which greatly reduces development costs. ### Quick Implementation Effect Let’s discuss the quick implementation effect. From the left to the middle, on the far right is a low poly model. The middle is a Marvelous Designer (MD) model, and the last one is a high-mode production. This is an MP3 character we developed when the game was launched in the late middle of the year. Initially, we didn’t have enough budget to start making it from the original part, so we had a meeting with the designers. We brought it directly from the 3D production team and started customizing it according to their needs. On the left is a simple model of MD that we put on the Z20. Through the product development process, including the MP3, we started to make it. Finally, we went to the Z20 on the far right and finished the high mode. The entire process took about 7-8 days, including meetings. This is very fast; making it from the original part would take about half a month because the original part is more refined. These are all due to its powerful extension function. ### Cost Reduction Last year, I also made a work of my own, combining the image of a Chinese woman with cyberpunk. During this process, I conducted a lot of research. For example, on the left, there are some Dongmao images or vest images. I think Marvelous Designer can really help people like me—those who don't have strong design capabilities—solve this problem and understand and optimize designs better. This software can also help us save costs. I believe this is the most mentioned word, especially regarding cost reduction. For instance, in the Resonate project, we established an MDT warehouse and accumulated many high-quality clothing assets, including copyright information. We also classified these assets into tops, bottoms, and accessories, including backpacks. All of these have been refined. For new characters, if there is a similar type of clothing, we can use it to modify it. After establishing the MDT warehouse, we calculated that the development time for the team was reduced by about 30% to 50%. The three pictures below illustrate the designs of three different characters in our project. Overall, the design is not much different; it is a two-sided design. The top is all cloth. When we were making it, we used the same kind of clothing and made some changes in the details, resulting in significant time savings. ## Key Considerations in Project Development In the project, we need to pay attention to several key factors. First, we focus on the length of the fabric in the game. In the end, the fabric length will directly affect the visual effect of the game and some performance problems. ### Performance of Screentone One point to note is the performance of the screentone, especially since this is a mobile experience. When designing, we will pay attention to the screentone of the character. Additionally, in the 3D production environment, we emphasize wide-ranging performance to achieve more practical visual impact in the game. Sometimes, we find that in many places, the screentone is not very good. Our 3D production team will self-explain and adjust things like this. ### Material Characteristics As much as possible, we aim to open up the different material characteristics in objects. For instance, we see examples of bags, backpacks, t-shirts, and pants movements. Moreover, we utilize Zbrush for structural additions in the simulation of MD. We also focus on enriching character performance by opening up materials, providing a more realistic idea. ### Layer Interweaving The interweaving of layers is another key aspect. The senior team mentioned that when we are working on material, whether for the interior or exterior, we often face limitations in production. The materials can be visually appealing, but fine materials may not be suitable for the character's overall performance. ## Summary of Marvelous Designer Advantages To summarize, the advantages of Marvelous Designer (MD) for this project include: 1. **Promoting Creativity**: MD provides a clean environment, and practical feedback can encourage designers to explore more creative solutions. 2. **High-End Fabric Simulation**: This has been MD's advantage from the beginning. Traditional modeling requires strong software and professional knowledge, but with MD, artists can start designing clothing and fabric with basic art knowledge. 3. **Short Production Cycle**: The emergence of MD, particularly in production, will significantly speed up our work processes and improve the efficiency of our artists. If there are overlaps in the middle, costs will be considerably lower than before. In conclusion, the core value of MD is that it allows game designers to create more, have more freedom, enjoy a higher degree of creativity, and incur lower development costs. ## Closing Remarks Thank you for your attention. I also want to talk about something else. In the past few years, with the rise of AI, the game industry has made significant progress. From the beginning of Rising to now, there have been twists and turns along the way. I almost couldn't meet you all, but in the end, we completed the project. Confidence is crucial for both individuals and teams; it determines the direction of our work and our judgment. I hope everyone will not be influenced by the atmosphere of exchanges and will continue to do what they love. Finally, I want to thank the host for creating such a wonderful platform for communication. If you are interested in this project, feel free to ask questions. I’m not sure if there are any fans of Fate here today, but we have received a lot of positive feedback from players. However, we learned through overseas tests that European and American players have different preferences from us; they tend to favor PC or large-scale games over mobile games. We are currently trying to optimize the PC version. If you are interested, there will be an overseas test in the first half of this year, along with more information about the game at the 520 gaming conference online. Well, that's it. Thank you! ```
